content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) provides resources aimed at improving access to care and enhancing the quality of diabetes management. Organizations such as the National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIDDK) play a pivotal role in offering evidence-based guidance to healthcare systems that seek to transform their diabetes care practices. By leveraging tools such as patient registries and electronic health records (EHRs), healthcare systems can systematically assess the quality of care they provide. These tools enable the tracking of patient outcomes and facilitate the implementation of structured quality improvement cycles, ensuring that care delivery is both effective and continuously optimized.
